{{Quote|Ah, you're in luck! Today, we're trading Mooth's delicious swamp pickles! They're, uh&hellip;really great!|Wicket makes a sales pitch to the Kagles|<ref name="HS" />}}
'''Swamp pickles''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] native to the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. While creatures like the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] found the [[Pickle/Legends|pickles]] repulsive, they were adored by the [[Kagles]], who purchased several of them from the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Mooth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] after receiving some from the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], who were trading them for Mooth.

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Go ahead, Teebo. Take a bite.''"<br />"''Do I have to?|Wicket and Teebo|<ref name="HS" />}}
Curving and cylindrical, the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] swamp [[Pickle/Legends|pickle]] was pink in [[Color/Legends|color]], and had a green stem on one end and long, brown protrusions on the other. They also had a distinctive taste and a strong odor, which was strong enough to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. The pickles were despised by the moon's native [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], but relished by the [[Kagles]].<ref name="HS" />

==History==
{{Quote|We ''love'' Mooth's swamp pickles! Eat them all the time!''"<br />"''All the time!|The Kagles describe their adoration for swamp pickles|<ref name="HS" />}}
[[File:TeeboSwampPickle-HS.png|thumb|left|200px|Teebo hesitantly takes a bite of a swamp pickle.]]
The Kagles of Endor enjoyed eating swamp pickles and frequently purchased them from the [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Mooth]].<ref name="HS" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Pickle/Legends|pickles]]|[[Hard Sell]]}}</ref> when Mooth fell ill with a [[Cold/Legends|cold]], he tasked the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] with trading his belongings until he felt well enough to do so himself. In return, Mooth would grant the Ewok who could trade the most a pair of [[Eodon]] [[Tooth/Legends|tusks]]. Warrick and Teebo journeyed to the home of the Kagles and offered to sell them some swamp pickles. In order to demonstrate their quality, Warrick ordered Teebo to consume one of them; Teebo, holding his nose to avoid the pickle's terrible smell, begrudgingly acquiesced, and subsequently fainted from the [[Plant/Legends|plant's]] taste. However, the Kagles assured Warrick that no convincing was in order, as they had a strong fondness for the pickles. The Kagles took several jars of them but informed Warrick that they had nothing to trade at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. Later, however, the Kagles went to [[Mooth's trading post]] and offered the trader their [[Kagle family cold cure|family cold cure]] in exchange for more of the pickles.<ref name="HS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The swamp pickle makes its first appearance in "[[Hard Sell]],"<ref name="HS" /> the eleventh episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series. "Hard Sell," written by [[Michael Reaves]] and directed by [[Raymond Jafelice]], originally aired on [[October 25]], [[1986]]."<ref name="A Star Wars CELibration">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
